mapper.select: SELECT `id`, `name`, `category`, `kcal`, `carbs`, `protein`, `fat`, `fiber`, `unit`, `approxUnit`, `userId`, `isDeleted`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt` FROM `Ingredients` WHERE `userId` = #{userId} AND `isDeleted` = 0 ORDER BY `updatedAt` DESC, `id` DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `Ingredients` SET `name` = #{name}, `category` = #{category}, `kcal` = #{kcal}, `carbs` = #{carbs}, `protein` = #{protein}, `fat` = #{fat}, `fiber` = #{fiber}, `unit` = #{unit}, `approxUnit` = #{approxUnit}, `updatedAt` = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE `id` = #{id} AND `userId` = #{userId} AND `isDeleted` = 0
